'''Serap's landing strip''' was located in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Cairn (city)|Cairn]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Seikosha/Legends|Seikosha]]. It was little more than packed dirt surrounded by [[Concrete/Legends|concrete]] walls.
